body:
**Describe the bug**
`@actions/glob@0.7.0` depends on `minimatch@^10.2.5`. GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (CVE-2026-118764, globparts amplification DoS, CWE-405) affects every minimatch below 11.0.1, and there is no 10.x fix (10.2.6 is the last 10.x release). Anything that depends on `@actions/glob` or `@actions/cache` (which pulls in `@actions/glob ^0.7.0`) now trips OSV-Scanner, Dependabot and `npm audit`, and consumers can't fix it themselves.

I can't just override minimatch to 11 in my own project. `packages/glob/src/internal-pattern.ts` calls `this.minimatch.matchOne(...)` (the root-path workaround near line 174), and minimatch 11.0.0 removed `matchOne()` from the public API. I read the 11.0.1 tarball: `matchOne` is only a private `#matchOne` there. I did not run it, but `partialMatch` would hit it for every non-matching item during traversal, so I expect a `TypeError: this.minimatch.matchOne is not a function`.

**To Reproduce**
1. Install `@actions/cache@latest` (or `@actions/glob@0.7.0`). It resolves `minimatch@10.2.5`.
2. Run `osv-scanner --lockfile=<your lockfile>`, or `npm audit`.
3. See GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 reported against minimatch, fixed in 11.0.1.

**Expected behavior**
A `@actions/glob` release that depends on `minimatch@^11.0.1` and no longer relies on `Minimatch#matchOne`, plus an `@actions/cache` release that picks it up.

**Additional context**
- For `@actions/glob` itself I think this is low impact. Patterns come from the caller, and the vulnerable path only runs at `optimizationLevel >= 2`, which `internal-pattern.ts` doesn't set (the default is 1). It still shows up as a finding in every downstream scanner.
- minimatch 11.0.0 also removed `makeRe()`, `Minimatch#regexp`, `AST`, `slashSplit()` and the `debug` option. I only checked the `matchOne` call, so there may be other call sites.
- I searched open and closed issues and PRs for "minimatch" and for the GHSA id. I found nothing about minimatch 11. Related: #1955 (outdated minimatch, closed), #2355 (3.0.4 to 10.2.5, merged), #2408 (ESM named export in v10, open).

comments.body:
Confirmed this at runtime while updating link-foundation/links-notation#406 on Node 26.13.0, `@actions/glob@0.7.0`, and `minimatch@11.0.8`.

Minimal reproduction:

```sh
npm init -y
npm install @actions/glob@0.7.0
npm pkg set overrides.minimatch=11.0.8
npm install
mkdir -p fixture/nested
printf sample > fixture/nested/file.txt
node --input-type=module -e "import * as glob from '@actions/glob'; console.log(await (await glob.create('fixture/**/*')).glob())"
```

This throws `TypeError: this.minimatch.matchOne is not a function` from `Pattern.partialMatch`. Without the override, `npm audit` reports GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249. Thus a blanket minimatch override can make an audit pass while breaking actual artifact file discovery.

Our temporary workaround is to replace the direct `@actions/glob` dependency in the two affected archived action templates with `glob@14.0.6` plus `glob-parent@6.0.2`, and verify nested files, excluded patterns, hidden files, symlinks, search roots and empty evidence with an actual filesystem regression test. Artifact transport still uses `@actions/artifact`.

Suggested upstream change: move the dependency to minimatch 11 and replace the removed private traversal primitive with the supported `Minimatch#match(path, true)` partial matching API, preserving the existing Windows/root-path tests. Then consumers can return to the official SDK without a compatibility adapter.


The filesystem migration regression also covers implicit descendants for both
positive and negative directory patterns, ordered exclusions/re-inclusions,
multiple negation signs, comment lines and current-user tilde expansion. A
native glob ignore of `excluded-directory` alone still includes its children;
the adapter must expand descendants and preserve order rather than merge all
negative patterns globally. The five bounded tests for both action copies are
[here](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-405-e18bfd98e937/experiments/issue-405/artifact-files.test.mjs).

title: @actions/glob: move to minimatch 11 (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) and stop using Minimatch#matchOne
